description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 28.12.2015 to 03.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content involves no government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3, nor does it fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, Elections, Public Service, or Judicial matters.
